FFmpeg 7.1.5 + libdav1d 1.5.4 -- "decode-av1" LGPL static build for macOS arm64 and x86_64
Built 2026-10-06/07 on an Apple Silicon Mac (Apple clang 21.0.0, clang-2100.3.34.2) by the
ScrapeRight AV1 native lane (cache scraperight-av1-native-mac-r1). Retained bytes:
/Volumes/D/rightkit-publish/artifacts/ffmpeg-7.1.5-lgpl-dav1d/ (SHA256SUMS, provenance.json,
build-ffmpeg-macos.sh = the exact script that ran).

Purpose: AV1 decode (libdav1d) for ScrapeRight; keeps the catalog LGPL-only posture.

Sources
  ffmpeg-7.1.5.tar.xz  sha256 de668509caf9e35e3cd162473441fdb29538c6d96ed080292b3cf9e6fc5d558f
                       https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.5.tar.xz (unmodified)
  dav1d 1.5.4          https://github.com/videolan/dav1d.git tag 1.5.4,
                       commit 54706fc6bc0cdecab7e9593974a4039cc038fca7 (git checkout; no
                       tarball digest exists, so the catalog pins the commit). BSD-2-Clause;
                       third-party/dav1d-COPYING.txt is that checkout's COPYING.
  meson 1.9.2 (commit d11b8f26f372c844fcd24a82fa745244bb13c6e0) built dav1d.

dav1d: meson, --default-library static --buildtype release -Denable_tools=false
       -Denable_tests=false, cross file `clang -arch <arch>`, installed to a private prefix.
FFmpeg configure (exact; arm64):
  --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree --disable-autodetect --enable-static --disable-shared
  --disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-ffplay --enable-small --arch=arm64
  --target-os=darwin --enable-cross-compile --cc='clang -arch arm64' --enable-libdav1d
  --pkg-config-flags=--static
x86_64 is identical with arm64 replaced by x86_64. PKG_CONFIG_PATH is the private prefix only.

Verified: the arm64 and universal binaries ran on the build host (-version shows the
configuration line above). The x86_64 binary was NOT executed (no Rosetta on the build
host); its configuration line was read from the binary's embedded string and matches. The
runtime -version probe checks it again on first use on an x86_64 host.
Use: separate executable the app shells out to; notice + source offer apply.
